app.name: MyDownloader
app.tagline: Download music & videos — fast, clean, in your format.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.subtitle: Your starting point — all areas and the current state at a glance.

download.label: New download
download.sub: Grab a video, song or entire playlist

download.title: New download
download.subtitle: Paste a URL, check the preview, download — single item or playlist.

preview.title: Preview
preview.empty: Paste a URL — the preview loads automatically.

options.title: Options for this download
options.extraQualitiesHint: Each additional level creates a separate download with a quality suffix in the filename.

errors.invalidUrl: That does not look like a valid URL.

combi.title: Video or playlist?
combi.question: This link contains a single video AND a playlist. What should be downloaded?

extras.title: Extras for this download
extras.sectionHint: Leave empty to download the whole video. Format: ss, mm:ss or hh:mm:ss.
extras.splitChaptersHint: Creates one file per chapter (if the video has chapters).
extras.chaptersFound: {n} chapters detected — each becomes its own file.

queue.title: Queue
queue.subtitle: All running, waiting and finished downloads of this session.
queue.empty: The queue is empty. Start a new download from the overview.
queue.notStartedHint: {n} download(s) waiting — the queue only starts when you click “Start queue”.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: All completed downloads — searchable and filterable.
history.confirmClear: Really delete the entire history? Downloaded files are kept.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Defaults for all downloads. Individual downloads can override them.

fields.sponsorBlock: SponsorBlock: remove sponsor segments from videos
fields.playlistSubfolder: Download playlists into their own subfolders
fields.extraArgsHint: Experts only — appended to yt-dlp verbatim.
fields.scheduleEnabled: Only download within a time window
fields.scheduleHint: The queue then only downloads between start and end (e.g. at night). Manually started downloads always run immediately.
fields.musicSourceHint: Applies to Spotify imports and other searches without a fixed URL. YouTube Music usually returns the album version instead of the music video.
fields.fetchLyricsHint: Looks up lyrics via LRCLIB; synced lyrics are also saved as .lrc files.
fields.closeToTray: Closing minimizes to the system tray
fields.closeToTrayHint: Downloads keep running in the background; quit via the tray menu.
fields.styleHint: Both styles come in light and dark. “New” is the urbDesign system with glass surfaces.

binaries.title: Components
binaries.description: yt-dlp needs to stay current: YouTube regularly blocks the access paths used by older builds, after which downloads abort mid-way with "HTTP Error 403". Updates are written to a writable folder, so they also work for AppImage and system-wide installations.
binaries.outdated: yt-dlp is outdated (installed {current}, available {latest}). Please update, otherwise downloads will fail with HTTP 403.

importV3.title: Import from version 3
importV3.description: Imports settings and download history from MyDownloader v3 (settings.json / download_history.json).

account.title: YouTube account
account.description: Log in with your Google account to download age-restricted (18+) and members-only videos. Login happens in a real browser window; only the cookies are stored — locally on this device.
account.useCookiesHint: Required for 18+ content. Cookies are only passed to yt-dlp on this device.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: About this application.
about.stack: Built with Electron, Vue 3, yt-dlp and FFmpeg.
featureList: Videos, songs, playlists, shorts & whole channels
Queue with parallel downloads, pause & resume
Playlist subscriptions: only new items download automatically
Spotify track links: the song is fetched from YouTube
System tray, drag & drop, deep links
Light, dark & colorful mode, German & English

templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Download presets: define format, quality and folders once, reuse them anytime.
templates.editSubtitle: View and edit share the same form — apply changes with “Save”.
templates.empty: No templates yet. Create your first preset with “New template”.

subscriptions.title: Playlist subscriptions
subscriptions.subtitle: Subscribed playlists and channels are checked for new videos automatically — only new items get downloaded.
subscriptions.added: Subscription created — only new videos will be downloaded from now on.
subscriptions.empty: No subscriptions yet. Add a playlist or channel URL above.
subscriptions.foundNew: {n} new items found and added to the queue
subscriptions.deleteQuestion: Really delete subscription “{name}”? Downloaded files are kept.

spotify.title: Spotify import
spotify.subtitle: Paste a Spotify track link, the song is then fetched from YouTube.
spotify.howItWorks: Nothing is downloaded from Spotify itself. The link is only read for artist and title, the file then comes from YouTube. No account or login needed.
spotify.linkHint: A link to a single song, for example from the share menu of the Spotify app.
spotify.invalidLink: That is not a link to a single Spotify track.
spotify.playlistsLater: Whole playlists and albums will follow later. For now this is about single songs.
spotify.sourceYtmusic: The song is looked up on YouTube Music, which usually finds the album version instead of the music video. Change this in Settings under “Music source for searches”.
spotify.sourceYoutube: The song is looked up with the regular YouTube search, which often returns the music video. You can prefer YouTube Music in Settings.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.subtitle: Your download history in numbers — computed entirely locally.

onboarding.title: Welcome to MyDownloader
onboarding.welcomeText: Four quick steps to set up the essentials. Everything can be changed later.

dragdrop.hint: Drop links or .txt files here — they will be added to the queue
